writing this as a patient who feels deeply let down by the GP system in Bolton.

I developed what started as a cold burn, which has since turned into an open wound. It has still not healed and remains untreated properly despite me contacting my GP surgery on two separate occasions.

During my first visit, I was prescribed antibiotics. What concerned me most was that the doctor appeared unsure about the condition and searched online during the appointment to understand what it was and how to treat it. Seeing a medical professional rely on an internet search in front of me made me feel unsafe and worried that they didn’t fully understand what they were dealing with. I was given antibiotics and sent home, but there was no proper wound care, cleaning or dressing provided. The wound has still not healed.

I attended again on the 11 march because I was worried about infection and the lack of improvement. I waited for around an hour past my appointment time due to other issues at the practice, which I understand can happen when services are extremely busy. However, when I was finally seen, the appointment itself lasted only about two- three minutes. The doctor briefly looked at the wound and said I would be referred elsewhere. When I asked how long that would take, I was told “not long — around two weeks.”

I left feeling shocked and frustrated and I’m not someone who is outspoken so I couldn’t even ask the questions I truly wanted to ask, especially when I feel rushed in an environment. I don’t understand why a GP service cannot provide basic wound care such as cleaning the injury and applying the correct dressing. Being told to wait weeks with an open wound feels unacceptable and distressing.

I understand GP practices are under pressure and very busy and I am willing to put some delays down to how packed the surgery was. However, patients should still feel properly assessed, treated, and reassured especially when dealing with an open wound that risks 🥀infection🥀.

This situation has left me asking some serious questions about our health care quality

• What is the role of a GP if basic treatment isn’t provided?
• Why are patients left waiting with untreated wounds?
• What are we paying taxes for if essential frontline care isn’t accessible?
My visit to this GP has shown me that quantity over quality is more valued.

I understand the pressures on the National Health Service and that staff are often overstretched. However, patients should still feel safe, listened to and properly treated. Right now, I feel dismissed and let down by a system that is supposed to provide timely and 🥀competent care🥀.",null,[0,83]]]],[null,null,null,null,null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/11272074729760243841/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjFXUmxKVVFrTldNVUp2VGtWemVGVkZSalZPTUZKVVVURk9RMk5IWXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/11272074729760243841/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjFXUmxKVVFrTldNVUp2VGtWemVGVkZSalZPTUZKVVVURk9RMk5IWXhBQhAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/11272074729760243841/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjFXUmxKVVFrTldNVUp2VGtWemVGVkZSalZPTUZKVVVURk9RMk5IWXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/11272074729760243841/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjFXUmxKVVFrTldNVUp2VGtWemVGVkZSalZPTUZKVVVURk9RMk5IWXhBQhAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/11272074729760243841/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjFXUmxKVVFrTldNVUp2VGtWemVGVkZSalZPTUZKVVVURk9RMk5IWXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/11272074729760243841/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjFXUmxKVVFrTldNVUp2VGtWemVGVkZSalZPTUZKVVVURk9RMk5IWXhBQhAA"]],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21WRlJUQkNWMUJvTkVzeFVFRjVOMFJUUTFOQ2NHYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x93e94a585979e263!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOmVFRTBCV1BoNEsxUEF5N0RTQ1NCcGc%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21WRlJUQkNWMUJvTkVzeFVFRjVOMFJUUTFOQ2NHYxAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwi3toKHnauTAxVfRYQGHVr6LzAQoykIDSgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwi3toKHnauTAxVfRYQGHVr6LzAQ0pMFCAsoAw"],null,"CAESYENBRVFCQnBDUTJrNFNVRlNTVzVEWjI5QlVEY3lSMHd0TFd4Q1RsOWZSV2hCVjJsZlUyeENSRmRmVUVwdFZHOVBjMEZCUVVGQlIyZG1YMEZ0VEMwdGJFSk9SMEZCYVVGQg=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25aWmJGWXlkVWhyYlZwRU9ITkdSMFZYU1RkNmVrRRAB",["0x0:0x93e94a585979e263",null,1773837961967656,1773837961967656,[null,null,["https://www. are so many things that could be done better at Bolton General Practice but judging by the reviews, they have no intention of improving their services.
Where do I start? From the very beginning they messed up my appointment. I had a telephone interview on the 7th of June but they couldn't even leave a message to let me know it was cancelled.

Then randomly I received a call on the 11th of June instead when the nurse Gemma told me she had been sick. That's ok, it would have been nice to have been informed by the admin staff but it was fine.

We then booked an appointment for today at 8am because I informed her that I start work at 8:30am. She (Gemma) assured me that she would be in the Practice from 8am anyways so not to worry.

This is where it gets worse. I arrive before 8am but wait outside until 8am then make my way to reception. I inform them about my appointment. Now, it would have been great if the receptionists had told me at that point that Gemma wasn't actually in. I would have happily rearranged my appointment and left so I could make it to work on time.

Instead, they let me sit there even though I asked a couple times if they could please check with her as I didn't want to be late. One receptionist told me she wasn't logged in so she couldn't check which was obviously not true as I realised later that Gemma hadn't arrived yet.

Then at 8:07am, a lady strolls in and doesn't acknowledge me so I didn't know at this point that it was Gemma. She casually checks her schedule and talks with the receptionists briefly then goes into a consultation room. She comes out a couple times and goes back in without once acknowledging me, despite knowing that I had specifically booked an appointment with her for 8am.

At 8:12am, one of the receptionist whispers to the other and I catch the name "Gemma". I guess at this point, even she realises that she should be proactive and do something. She then goes into the same consultation room the lady went in earlier. She comes out in a few seconds and tells me that Gemma won't be long. It's at this point I know that the lady was Gemma.

Gemma never once acknowledged me. Surely, if you're late for an appointment you would apologise for being late especially as you knew I was waiting. It's funny because if a patient had been even 5mins late, their appointment would have been cancelled.

At 8:15am, I'd had enough. I was going to be late for work and Gemma had yet to come out of the room. At what time was she going to begin? All I wanted was some travel vaccines!

I then go to the reception and tell them I'm leaving as I had to go to work. I guess Gemma overhears the conversation through the open door of the consultation room because for the first time, she comes out and addresses me.

I wasn't rude and never raised my voice. I just calmly informed them that I couldn't wait any longer as I was going to be late. Gemma then tells me that she getting the vaccines ready and was stuck in traffic which is why she was late, and that she was almost done.

The thing is, she knew I was coming today. It's ok if you're late but at least address the patient waiting for you! Only when I was leaving did she come out and address me.

Also, why didn't the receptionists just tell me she was running late as I specifically told them I had to be at work for 8:30am and I was there to see Gemma.

In addition, there were other staff I'm assuming were doctors and nurses chatting and laughing just around the corner. One even walked back and forth, looking directly at me. Could none have asked to help?

I guess this is another reason the NHS is going downhill. It is already nearly impossible to book an appointment so what do they do all day?
Anyways, this was a long rant but I had to get it off my chest. I rarely go to the doctors, last time was probably over 2yrs ago and still they are incompetent.

I now do not have enough time to find another GP, register and then book travel vaccines before I go away so I'm having to go without any travel vaccines.
Thanks Bolton General Practice for nothing!",null,[0,238]]]],[null,null,null,null,null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/11272074729760243841/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTnhPVGRRVkc1M1JSQUIQAA%3D%3D",[null,null,null,"/local/business/11272074729760243841/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTnhPVGRRVkc1M1JSQUIQAA%3D%3D"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/11272074729760243841/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTnhPVGRRVkc1M1JSQUIQAA%3D%3D",[null,null,null,"/local/business/11272074729760243841/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTnhPVGRRVkc1M1JSQUIQAA%3D%3D"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/11272074729760243841/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTnhPVGRRVkc1M1JSQUIQAA%3D%3D",[null,null,null,"/local/business/11272074729760243841/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTnhPVGRRVkc1M1JSQUIQAA%3D%3D"]],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNxOTdQVG53RRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x93e94a585979e263!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEICAgICq97PTnwE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNxOTdQVG53RRAB&t=1&entityid=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNxOTdQVG53RRItChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNxOTdQVFh3EhNDZ3dJeHZuSGhnWVFrTGpXeEFFGi4KF0NJSE0wb2dLRUlDQWdJQ3E5N1BUM3dFEhNDZ3dJeHZuSGhnWVFrTGpXeEFFIhIJAAAAAAAAAAARY-J5WVhK6ZMqE0Nnd0l4dm5IaGdZUWtMald4QUU&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwi42eS2oKuTAxUDd4QGHR-dONMQoykICigB"],null,[null,[[1,4]]]],"0ahUKEwi42eS2oKuTAxUDd4QGHR-dONMQ0pMFCAgoAg"],null,"CAESZENBRVFfd0lhUkVOcVJVbEJVa2x3UTJkdlFWQTNNa2xZVEhaS2FucGZYMFZvUTNWVE5IcFRObXBMV1VOaE5VOVhhV05CUVVGQlFVZG5iamt6ZVd0RGFHTjFPRzFRVFZsQlEwbEI="],[["ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNxdGJIYzlnRRAB",["0x0:0x93e94a585979e263",null,1623670582345860,1623670582345860,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/106939864591890421968/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Florin
